en: Black‑and‑white image showing a small, octagonal or circular chapel with a shingled, conical roof topped by a tiny belfry or turret. The chapel stands on a slight rise at the end of a narrow dirt path bordered by low posts and wire. Leafless or sparsely leafed trees surround the building, and the overall mood is rural and quiet, resembling an old photographic postcard.
